name: Yo-Kai Watch Heartsong
source:
A fabulous new visual novel set in an original continuity for Yokai Watch with a magical twist!

In a world where the line between han'yo (that's half-human, half-yokai!) and human is much blurrier, things are harmonious and idyllic. That is, until strange unnatural creatures called Yoma start appearing, being twisted husks of humans and unseen supernatural creatures called Yokai who's heart and soul has been locked off. The ones who summon Yoma, the Yoma Circus, have a sinister scheme to make a perfect world of only masterpieces, at the cost of annihilating anything and anyone they deem unworthy.

Two seemingly unrelated girls, the feisty and competitive Jun Hikada and the shy and quiet Airei Takatsuki, may have a connection in being the keys in stopping the Yoma and deciding the future...

Their paths intertwine, and even though the truth may not be ideal at times, the fate of free will lies in their hands, as well as any yokai they befriend!

[From [url=https://bruceisloose.itch.io/yo-kai-watch-heartsong]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一部精彩的全新视觉小说，以《妖怪手表》的原创连续性为背景，并带有神奇的转折！

在半妖（半人半妖怪！）和人类之间的界限更加模糊的世界里，一切都是和谐而田园诗般的。也就是说，直到称为Yoma的奇怪非自然生物开始出现，它们是人类的扭曲外壳和称为Yokai的看不见的超自然生物，其心脏和灵魂已被锁定。召唤尤玛的人，尤玛马戏团，有一个险恶的计划，要创造一个只有杰作的完美世界，代价是消灭他们认为不值得的任何人和任何人。

活泼好胜的日田纯和害羞安静的高槻爱怜这两个看似毫无关系的女孩，可能在成为阻止耀马、决定未来的关键方面存在着某种联系……

他们的道路交织在一起，尽管真相有时可能并不理想，但自由意志的命运掌握在他们以及他们结交的任何妖怪手中！

[来自[url=https://bruceisloose.itch.io/yo-kai-watch-heartsong]itch.io[/url]]
